subject: The 10-second setting you're missing
preview_text: One tiny tweak that cuts through road noise instantly. No distortion, no volume spike. Try it now.
body_paragraphs: You're on the train. Podcast host whispers something important. Then the brakes screech. You jam the volume up. Now it's loud, but it's garbled. That's not your ears. That's the default EQ.

Here's the trick that 100,000+ users swear by: open the app, tap the Podcast profile. That's it. One tap rebalances the audio so voices cut through noise instead of drowning in it. No more straining. No more rewind.

We tuned this profile specifically for spoken word in chaotic environments. It lifts the mid-range where human speech lives, and tames the bass that masks it. Your ears will thank you. And your phone speaker won't blow out.
Open Loud EQ right now. Tap the Podcast profile. Hear the difference in 10 seconds. P.S. This also works for audiobooks and phone calls. Try it with your next commute.
